description: Code-to-rule map for every diagnostic code the reference prototype (reference/prototype/checker.py, coloured.py, durable.py) and the agent kit (agent-kit/.agents/skills/weave/scripts/) can emit. Each code has exactly one principal rule and optional secondary rules. Category 'specification': rule IDs from rules.json. Category 'kit-extension': rule IDs of the agent kit's pure fn extension, defined in agent-kit/docs/weave.md, outside the specified fragment. Category 'tool': not a language diagnostic; rule is null. related_roles lists the related-span roles a diagnostic of that code carries. scripts/refresh_reference_pages.py generates the tables in docs/chapters/diagnostics.rst from this file; agent-kit/.agents/skills/weave/assets/diagnostics.json is a byte-identical copy.

categories.specification: Language diagnostic of the reference prototype; the rule is a rule ID in rules.json
categories.kit-extension: Diagnostic of the agent kit's pure fn extension; the rule is a kit rule ID defined in agent-kit/docs/weave.md
categories.tool: Runner failure outside the checker; no rule applies

E001.meaning: Tab, invalid indentation, skipped level, unexpected block
E001.correction: Use four spaces and a valid block header

E002.meaning: Invalid type, parameter, brackets, or comma list
E002.correction: Use nominal types and identifier indices

E003.meaning: Duplicate/invalid net declaration, unexpected nested content, or a duplicated match case tag
E003.correction: Check declaration grammar and uniqueness; name each match case once

E100.correction: Make signatures, issuers, cancellations, and arcs agree

E101.meaning: Unauthorized resource/runtime consumption or activation read
E101.correction: Use only declared consumers; do not bypass sealing

E110.correction: Restrict names and integer arithmetic appropriately

E111.correction: Correct initialization or the intended equality

E112.correction: Correct the transition or revisit the contract explicitly
E112.note: Preservation by every transition column is defined in verification.rst, Aggregate invariants, which has no rule ID of its own.

E200.meaning: Invalid flow declaration or unsupported statement

E201.correction: Supply all required arguments, including permits

E202.meaning: Discarded non-Unit result or resource payload

E203.meaning: Use after move or double consumption
E203.correction: Transfer each live linear binding once

E204.meaning: Live linear obligations at normal/propagated return
E204.correction: Consume, hand off, or return them on every path

E205.meaning: Attempt to construct a sealed resource
E205.correction: Obtain it from its authorized issuer API

E206.correction: Use an exported API or same-file helper

E208.meaning: Wrong nominal type, arity, or unresolved call identity

E209.correction: Use the permit belonging to the requested identity

E212.correction: Use the supported awaited call form

E213.correction: Match a live enum at the end of the block

E214.meaning: Missing or undeclared match cases (a case tag written twice reports E003)
E214.correction: Cover exactly the declared case set

E215.correction: End with return or exhaustive terminal match

E216.correction: Bind result indices and use supported types

E218.correction: Use an acyclic F0 call graph

E219.correction: Use a case of that result

E320.correction: Inspect the trace and repair the protocol

E321.correction: Report NOT ESTABLISHED; review the model and limits

E400.meaning: Invalid coloured syntax, sorts, or model
E400.correction: Preserve colour arity and required declarations

E411.correction: Use valid per-colour or aggregate accounting

E420.note: durable.py also reports E420 when the R0 model refuses a cross-order firing.

E422.correction: Report NOT ESTABLISHED, not successful verification

P400.meaning: Unsupported or malformed pure syntax, operators, or declarations
P400.correction: Use only the constructs of the pure extension

P401.meaning: Unsupported type, including linear resources, in a pure signature
P401.correction: Use Int, Bool, IntList or IntListPair

P402.correction: Give each function and parameter its own name

P403.meaning: Unknown binding, or a function used as a value
P403.correction: Bind the name first; call functions instead of passing them

P404.correction: Declare the function or use a listed primitive

P406.meaning: Wrong argument type, including a <= operand
P406.correction: Pass values of the declared types

P407.correction: Return a value of the declared return type

P408.meaning: Malformed branch: missing else, statements after return or if, or a path without return
P408.correction: End every path with return or a terminal if/else

P409.meaning: Illegal effect: await, a net or foreign operation, or a flow call

P410.meaning: Flow declared in a pure program
P410.correction: Put flows and pure functions in separate files

P412.correction: Write two branches that call user functions and do not read each other

P420.meaning: head or tail of an empty list at run time
P420.correction: Test is_empty before head or tail

P424.meaning: Entry arguments are not valid JSON of the declared types
P424.correction: Pass a JSON array matching the entry signature

P426.correction: Report it as a kit defect

P427.meaning: Internal fork/join pairing error; never expected
P427.correction: Report it as a kit defect

TOOL_ERROR.meaning: The agent-kit runner failed outside the checker: unreadable input, invalid usage, a scenario or runtime-model assertion, or a timeout
TOOL_ERROR.correction: Fix the input or invocation; this is not a language diagnostic
